entries.land_location_as_stated: on the shore of Silver Lake, in the rapidly suburbanizing South Shore area of Massachusetts
entries.description: A 100-acre farm with woods, swamp, cranberry bog, and gardens on Silver Lake lived on by a couple who offer camping, farmwork experience, and longer term apprenticeships to women and children, while working to organize support for a land trust.
entries.raw_text: FEATHERS FARM Box 19, Bryantville, MA 02327 (617)585-3826. My partner & I are the only residents of Feathers Farm, 100 acres of woods, swamp, cranberry bog & gardens on the shore of Silver Lake, in the rapidly suburbanizing South Shore area of Massachusetts. We have camping facilities/open space/ farmwork experience to women and children. We are currently working to organize support and resources for a land trust to control this property. We have found lesbian separatism to be unworkable and alienating approach to this endeavor and expect unconditional acceptance of this from our visitors (whom we welcome AND encourage). We request that visitors bring their own food & donate $4/night camping fee, flexible. We often work out other arrangements for longer term apprenticeships or short term large groups. It is helpful if visits are preceeded by at least a phonecall, preferably a letter.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land following the two-woman rule ('My partner & I are the only residents of Feathers Farm'); a land trust is only being organized and not yet established. Num_residents is 2 based on 'My partner & I'. Accepted groups include Lesbian women, Non-lesbian women, Girl children, and Boy children based on pre-1986 rule for 'women and children'. Focuses include Farming/self-sufficiency ('cranberry bog & gardens', 'farmwork experience') and Workshops/education ('longer term apprenticeships'). Separatism is explicitly rejected ('found lesbian separatism to be unworkable and alienating approach') and thus not coded.

entries.description: An intentional community of 4 lesbians on 113 acres of mountains and woods in Maine, with parcels available for sale or building, offering camping, hiking, and welcoming new residents, non-lesbian women, girl children, and lesbians interested in buying land.
entries.raw_text: WOMONGROUND Rt 1, Box 2420, Troy, ME 04987. 113 acres of Maine mountains/woodland. Parcels available for sale and/or building. Also plenty of space for camping, hiking, raspberry picking. Will answer all letters promptly. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women, lesbians interested in buying land. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 113 acres, housing/permanent structures, camping space, woods, women working and living on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative as 4 lesbians are living and working on the land and recruiting new members. Land address matches rural route mailing address. Num_residents is 4 based on questionnaire count '4 lesbians' confirmed by 'women working and living on the land'. Accepted groups include Lesbian women ('lesbians interested in buying land'), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), and Girl children ('girl children').

entries.description: A 20-acre property with two dwellings built by dykes, owned collectively, currently rented to heterosexuals, seeking lesbian renters.
entries.raw_text: GENEROUS EARTH LAND Box 51A, Hinesburg, VT 05461. 20 acres, creek, woods, open. 2 dyke-built dwellings, one large, one small. No plumbing or electricity. None of the dyke collective owners live there now. It's rented to hets. Interested in dyke renters. 15 miles from town with jobs. Write before visiting.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative based on 'dyke collective owners'. Num_residents is 0 ('None of the dyke collective owners live there now. It's rented to hets.'). Land state inferred from contact address in VT. Accepted groups coded Lesbian women ('Interested in dyke renters').

entries.description: A working vegetarian homestead farm with secluded land and campsites, draft horse, dairy goats, chickens, and an all-lesbian maple sugar bush, offering retreats, ski weekends, work exchanges, workshops, and leasing land to women wanting to build a cabin or tipi.
entries.raw_text: GREENHOPE Box 226, E Hardwick, VT 05836. (802)533-7772. At present we are a working homestead farm. We offer year round space to women needing retreat or temporary living situation. We have gorgeous secluded land and campsites. Hope to build visitor cabins this summer. Women from the Boston area visit almost every weekend. Right now we are offering x-country ski weekends — $35 plus meals is the fee. In summer we offer work exchange. We have an all lesbian maple sugar bush — the only one I know of. We work with a draft horse, raise dairy goats and chickens. We are vegetarians raising nearly all our food organically here. We welcome community members and will lease land to women wanting to build a cabin or tipi.We offer workshops in
